svg.text: Weekly npm downloads of each protocol's main SDK
Log scale, 21 Apr 2025 to 5 Oct 2026. Each line starts at the first week with downloads. Downloads include CI and mirrors.

cheqd: Data exists (1.2K a week) but not plotted: the palette allows eight series
Other packages, with downloads in the last month
Maven, NuGet, Go modules, crates.io, RubyGems and any other registry, and packages whose name I could not identify.
One package per protocol is plotted. The window opens 21 Apr 2025, so earlier history for MCP, x402 and Web Bot Auth is not shown.
Each line starts at the first week with downloads.
Packages: MCP: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk; A2A: @a2a-js/sdk; x402: x402; MPP: mppx
Web Bot Auth: web-bot-auth; UCP: @ucp-js/sdk; KYA-OS: @kya-os/mcp; x401: @proof.com/x401-node
